newsitem.title: USA: AT&T enters arbitration with U S West.
newsitem.headline: AT&T enters arbitration with U S West.

text.p: Arbitration proceedings between AT&T Corp and U S West Communications Group begin Tuesday in an effort to bring local telephone service competition to Colorado, AT&T said.
During the arbitration, the Colorado Public Utilities Commission will hear testimony from both companies and other potential new entrants, the company explained.
It noted the commission has decided to begin deliberations in March 1997 of pricing issues that are essential for local competition.

Under the Federal Telecommunications Act passed earlier this year, companies seeking to offer local service can ask state regulators to intervene and settle disputed or unresolved issues. Formal talks between the two companies began March 1 when AT&T asked U S West to negotiate an agreement to allow it to connect to the local telephone network.
